ARXML signal initial values not loaded correctly for different AUTOSAR versions

When loading ARXML files, signal initial values are not being loaded correctly due to incorrect version checking logic. The issue affects both AUTOSAR 3.x and 4.x files.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load AUTOSAR 4.x file
db4 = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-4.2.arxml')
alarm_signal = db4.get_message_by_name('AlarmStatus').signals[0]
print(f"AUTOSAR 4.x FireAlarm initial value: {alarm_signal.initial}")
# Expected: 0, Actual: None

# Load AUTOSAR 3.x file  
db3 = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/arxml/system-3.2.3.arxml')
static_signal = db3.get_message_by_name('Multiplexed').get_signal_by_name('Static')
print(f"AUTOSAR 3.x Static initial value: {static_signal.initial}")
# Expected: False, Actual: None
```

The initial values are returning `None` instead of the expected values defined in the ARXML files. This affects signal processing and default value handling in CAN message decoding.
</issue>
